page_title: BOC 1-0 PAU | Bochum v St. Pauli 15/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+6' Daniel Siebert has a clear sight and sees a foul from Morgan Guilavogui (St. Pauli).
90+4' The ref makes the signal that the yellow is cancelled but immediately brandishes a straight red to Adam Dzwigala (St. Pauli). He’s distraught but has to leave the field of play.

90+3' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Adam Dzwigala (St. Pauli), but referee Daniel Siebert must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
90+2' Adam Dzwigala (St. Pauli) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
90+2' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Philipp Hofmann walks off the pitch to be replaced by Jakov Medic (Bochum).
90+1' Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) goes on a mazy run through the defence and gets within shooting range inside the box, but his effort to the middle of the target is thwarted by Nikola Vasilj.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Noah Weisshaupt (St. Pauli) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
87' The corner is bent into the box and met with a firm header by Eric Smith (St. Pauli), but it's just over the bar.
87' The ball is out of play. St. Pauli win a corner kick.
87' It's time for a substitution. Adam Dzwigala (St. Pauli) comes on in place of Manolis Saliakas.
87' Alexander Blessin prepares a substitution. David Nemeth is replaced by Abdoulie Ceesay (St. Pauli).
83' Noah Weisshaupt (St. Pauli) strikes a shot towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it flies just wide of the left post.
83' 11:10 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
81' Substitution. James Sands (St. Pauli) in, Carlo Boukhalfa out.
81' Alexander Blessin decides to make a substitution. Oladapo Afolayan will be replaced by Scott Banks (St. Pauli).
81' A rebound falls kindly for Eric Smith (St. Pauli), but his shot from the edge of the box flies high over bar. None too pretty!
80' Substitution. Dani de Wit (Bochum) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Gerrit Holtmann walks off.
79' Oladapo Afolayan (St. Pauli) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
78' Matus Bero (Bochum) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
76' Matus Bero (Bochum) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
75' Gerrit Holtmann (Bochum) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
75' The resulting corner from Noah Weisshaupt (St. Pauli) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
73' Gerrit Holtmann (Bochum) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
72' Jackson Irvine (St. Pauli) goes into the referee's book for dissent.
71' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Noah Weisshaupt (St. Pauli) comes onto the pitch so that Danel Sinani can be given a rest.
69' What was Eric Smith (St. Pauli) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
67' 1 - 0 Goal! Moritz Broschinski puts a cross into the box and finds Philipp Hofmann (Bochum), who latches on to it and strikes the ball into the roof of the net. He makes it 1:0.
65' Here is a change. Koji Miyoshi is going off and Dieter Hecking gives the last tactical orders to Moritz Broschinski (Bochum).
64' Manolis Saliakas (St. Pauli) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
61' Matus Bero (Bochum) will take a corner kick.
60' Philipp Hofmann (Bochum) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
58' Jackson Irvine (St. Pauli) commits a foul during an attacking move.
56' Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards over the bar.
56' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Matus Bero (Bochum) inside the box. He lets fly towards the bottom left corner, but Nikola Vasilj was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
53' Jackson Irvine (St. Pauli) receives a lofted pass in the goal area and unleashes a dangerous header which sails a few inches over the bar!
52' Philipp Hofmann (Bochum) latches onto a lofted pass near the penalty spot, but sends his header miles wide of the right post.
51' Daniel Siebert blows his whistle and it's Morgan Guilavogui (St. Pauli) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
50' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) launches a cross from the corner, but Nikola Vasilj is alert to thwart the effort.
49' Philipp Hofmann (Bochum) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
48' Matus Bero (Bochum) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
46' Referee Daniel Siebert blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.

45' Matus Bero (Bochum) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Nikola Vasilj pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
43' The free kick from Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) failed to provide any scoring opportunity, as one of the defenders did a good job and knocked it out.
42' Gerrit Holtmann (Bochum) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
40' Oladapo Afolayan (St. Pauli) is adjudged offside.
39' Manolis Saliakas (St. Pauli) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
37' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
36' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 4:4.
34' The foul by Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) was seen by Daniel Siebert who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
33' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) unleashed a powerful long-range strike, but the ball was blocked by a defender on its way.
33' Matus Bero (Bochum) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.

31' Gerrit Holtmann (Bochum) weaves through the defence with ease and gets into a good position in front of goal. He pulls the trigger in an effort to beat the keeper, but fails as the ball zooms around the left post.
30' Morgan Guilavogui (St. Pauli) latches onto a lofted pass near the penalty spot only to head the ball yards wide of the left post.
29' Koji Miyoshi sprays a pass out to Gerrit Holtmann (Bochum), but he produces a poor effort from inside the box which goes well wide of the right post.
27' Jackson Irvine (St. Pauli) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Daniel Siebert signals.

24' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
22' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
21' David Nemeth (St. Pauli) is penalised for holding. Daniel Siebert signals a set piece.
18' Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.

16' Jackson Irvine (St. Pauli) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the middle of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
16' Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
15' Oladapo Afolayan (St. Pauli) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
15' Gerrit Holtmann (Bochum) unleashes a shot, but it's well wide of the left-hand post.
15' Matus Bero (Bochum) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
13' Philipp Hofmann (Bochum) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
12' Jackson Irvine (St. Pauli) was too forceful with his tackle and Daniel Siebert interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
10' Morgan Guilavogui (St. Pauli) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it goes well wide of the right post.
9' Manolis Saliakas (St. Pauli) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
8' Manolis Saliakas (St. Pauli) takes the corner which is cleared.
6' Bochum players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
2' Erhan Masovic (Bochum) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
2' A snap shot by Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom left corner, but Nikola Vasilj produces a good save to thwart him.
